notes: Known-answer prompts for general chat profiles. Every expected answer is a fact or a computation with exactly one correct value; the judge is deterministic (normalised substring / number / JSON-subset; number_equals reads the number after the last '=' when the answer restates an equation, else the first number). max_tokens (2048) leaves room for reasoning-channel models; only message.content is judged, and a completion cut off by the budget (finish_reason=length) or with empty content but reasoning content is UNDETERMINED, never FAIL and never PASS.

cases.prompt: What is 17 + 25? Answer with only the number.
Which number is larger, 9 or 4? Answer with only the number.
What is the capital city of France? Answer with one word.
Repeat exactly this code and nothing else: ZX-4417
Return a JSON object with exactly one key "color" whose value is the string "blue". Output only the JSON.
